title: Loop Before You Leap: What Recurrent Depth Can and Cannot Buy in Data-Limited Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.06206v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal models have often scored below text-only baselines in the BabyLM Challenge (Klerings et al., 2024; Takmaz et al., 2025). We test whether additional recurrent computation helps close this gap. Recurrence increases computation by reusing layers without adding parameters or training data. Using a single implementation, we compare standard and looped Transformers under a 100M-word budget, with three seeds per main condition. Each image is represented by one feature vector from a frozen DINOv2 encoder, used as a prefix token. Caption words count toward the budget, so multimodal training also changes the language data. In a pre-registered text-only comparison, a 12-layer stack repeated four times exceeds a standard 48-layer Transformer by 5.4 BLiMP percentage points at matched inference compute. However, multimodal training lowers BLiMP accuracy by about 3.8 points in both architectures, with no clear mitigation from recurrence. An

translated_title: 先循环，后飞跃：循环深度在数据受限预训练中能带来什么与不能带来什么
translated_abstract: 在BabyLM挑战赛中，多模态模型的表现往往低于纯文本基线（Klerings等人，2024；Takmaz等人，2025）。我们测试了额外的循环计算能否帮助缩小这一差距。循环机制通过重复使用层来增加计算量，而无需增加参数或训练数据。在单一实现下，我们在1亿词的预算下比较标准Transformer与循环Transformer，每个主要条件使用三个随机种子。每张图像由冻结的DINOv2编码器输出的一个特征向量表示，并作为前缀token使用。图像描述词计入预算，因此多模态训练也会改变语言数据本身。在一项预注册的纯文本比较中，重复四次的12层堆叠在推理计算量相同的情况下，其BLiMP得分比标准的48层Transformer高出5.4个百分点。然而，多模态训练使两种架构的BLiMP准确率均下降约3.8个百分点，且循环机制并未带来明显的缓解作用。
tldr: 该研究发现在1亿词的数据受限预训练中，循环深度（12层堆叠重复四次）在相同推理计算量下的纯文本任务中比标准48层Transformer高出5.4个BLiMP百分点，但无法缓解多模态训练导致的约3.8个百分点的语言能力下降。
en_tdlr: Under a 100M-word data-limited pretraining budget, recurrent depth (a 12-layer stack repeated four times) outperforms a standard 48-layer Transformer by 5.4 BLiMP points at matched inference compute in text-only settings, but it cannot mitigate the roughly 3.8-point language performance drop caused by multimodal training.
